limitations: Unlinked Git identities are estimates based on email or name; account matches and bot status are not inferred.
Commit dates do not establish when commits reached the default branch. Removed commits, force-pushes, rebases, and default-branch changes can revise historical results.
Deleted or inaccessible items and transferred issues can limit historical reconstruction.
Repository and actor names, subject titles, and URLs reflect collection-time metadata; historical display names are not reconstructed.
Review states and thread resolved/outdated flags reflect collection-time metadata.
Collection is not a transactional GitHub snapshot; concurrent changes and newly available data may revise results on a later rerun.
